t: Easydrive TX countersunk thread forming concrete screws, 6mm x 100mm, are designed for reliable light to medium duty fixing directly into concrete and most masonry types. These robust carbon steel screws, with a zinc-plated finish, offer corrosion resistance for indoor applications. Ideal for general builders and electricians, the countersunk flat head ensures a flush finish. A TX drive provides secure installation, while the thread forming A point tip and deep high/low thread deliver high pull-out resistance and efficient waste extraction, thanks to the serrated V-thread design. Heat-treated for enhanced durability, a pilot hole is normally required.
b: Deep High / Low Thread for High Pull-Out Resistance & Waste Extraction
